agents: six to eight native roles initially (custody ledger, math review, independent verifier, deployment/restore checker, claims review, publication scrub), up to twenty assignments in waves; all heavy work through the single queue
class5_limitation: Occupation class 5 has zero GUARD rows, two UPDATE rows and two FIT2 rows (inherited). Class order unchanged; class-specific statistics for class 5 not estimable; no protection claim for unsupported classes.
design_disclosure: This method and protocol were designed after observing the previous occupation-only adapter results (publication 604871a5aa9a8334525b8fcf4b509291067d46da), including its FIT2 and INNER outcomes. FIT2 and INNER are exposed development roles, not fresh confirmation. A new split would not undo prior exposure.
exposure_statement: Exploratory development on repeatedly used Adult people. Source models were trained on all FIT. All people are treated as repeatedly used development data. Intervals are conditional on the fitted models and readers and do not account for the adaptive research history; the two model seeds reuse the same people.
forbidden: modifying the completed occupation-only study or other source branches
host: existing local workstation (macOS, 14 cores, 24 GiB); the handoff's 'remote host' is this machine; no new paid resource
hypothesis_status: hypothesis only; the previous result did not prove that frozen income caused the coalition shortfall
newly_authorized_exports: income AND occupation task labels for UPDATE and GUARD; only UPDATE provides SEX to training critics
novelty: constrained prediction adaptation over frozen features; not automatically a novel algorithm or a population privacy guarantee
question: Does adapting BOTH recipients' transmitted predictions allow a useful coalition improvement (aligned-pair fresh-reader SEX recovery reduction > 0.020 AUC with simultaneous bounds) that occupation-only adaptation could not achieve?
stage_order: admission (income export, source/role admission, zero-residual witness, O_PREVIOUS admission)
SCIENCE_LOCK (code, config, bank, accounting, endpoints, attack slate, forecasts, selection rules) + scrubbed prefit receipt
FIT2 utility once + SELECTION_LOCK (nominations, attack roster, primary K=39 roster, diagnostic family)
